contracts.guarded_digest: each approval step binds the guarded step parameters and next steps
contracts.skill_agent_action_binding: service.action must exist in core.action_registry, including connector namespaces; otherwise non-executable
contracts.unsupported_entity_operation: execution_ready=false with an honest blocker; the declared operation is not rewritten

contracts.definition_resolution: execution/definition identity (_workflow_definition_id); persisted blueprint loaded by definition id when no memory registration exists; never scan for the first workflow containing the step id
contracts.hitl_queue_bridge: advanced WorkflowExecution actions use the same checkpoint consumer instead of the legacy workflow-engine state store
contracts.legacy_input_digest: accepted only when guarded_digest and the execution/definition binding agree; a changed input/guarded material is refused
contracts.legacy_non_server_required_without_row: documented pre-repair compatibility path; never waives a server-required checkpoint
contracts.release_condition: an actual approved HITLAction matching execution, definition, step, guarded material and scope
contracts.route_scope: HITLAction is loaded within the authenticated workspace/tenant and bound to execution/step/definition before a decision

contracts.completed_only_when: context is still RUNNING and required work succeeded
